footnotes.text: Decks and ramps not supported by a dwelling need not be provided with footings that extend below the frost line. (CT R403.1.4.1 Exception 3, p. 145)

The footing for the grade-level termination of stairs or ramps attached to decks or landings, whether the deck or landing is supported by a dwelling or not, shall only be required to be placed at least 12 inches (305 mm) below the undisturbed ground surface in accordance with Section R403.1.4. (CT R403.1.4.1 Exception 4, p. 145)
